title: EEG data during three near-threshold visual detection tasks: a no-cue task, a noninformative cue task (50% validity), and an informative cue task (100% validity)
description: EEG recordings from participants performing three near-threshold visual detection tasks that differed in cue information: a no-cue task, a noninformative cue task (50% validity), and an informative cue task (100% validity). The dataset was collected to study how prestimulus alpha-band activity relates to perception of near-threshold visual stimuli. It is shared in BIDS format.
methods_description: EEG data were collected during three near-threshold visual detection tasks with different cue validity conditions (no-cue, 50% validity noninformative cue, and 100% validity informative cue). Participants performed perceptual detection of visual stimuli presented at near-threshold intensity levels.
